title: beat_dl — the whole job
subtitle: YouTube → MP3 with BPM/key tagging, March 2026 → now. Refresh: edit tracker.json, then python3 ~/.claude/skills/progress-tracker/build_tracker.py tracker.json

items.title: First cut
items.detail: yt-dlp → MP3 into ~/Downloads, driven by a bash loop (run.sh) you feed URLs. Commits 58c71ba + 87e9615, 2026-03-24.

items.title: Double-click launchers
items.detail: run.command / install.command so it opens from Finder, no terminal. README documents the right-click→Open unsigned-app step. Shipped with the first cut.

items.title: Chrome cookie auth
items.detail: YouTube now demands a sign-in; the tool pulls cookies from a logged-in Chrome automatically. Documented in README §YouTube Login Requirement.

items.title: Daily link log
items.detail: Every success appends an Input URL / Downloaded pair to ~/Downloads/(YY-M-D) Youtube DL LINKS.txt. Format shown in README.

items.title: BPM + key tagging (librosa)
items.detail: bpm.py detects tempo and key and renames the file "name (142.0 BPM Cm D# Gm).mp3". Later measured at 30% exact BPM / 43.6% exact key — the baseline the September rewrite beat.

items.title: Messages DB dig
items.detail: Pulled the YouTube links out of two contacts' threads straight from the macOS Messages DB and scoped the download+heart loop. .remember/today-2026-06-05.done.md, Jun 5.

items.title: iMessage watcher spec
items.detail: Design approved (pending review): a link from either of two allowlisted contacts downloads itself through beat_dl and answers with a thumbs-up tapback. docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-05-imessage-watcher-design.md, commit e236dd4. Closed by J 2026-10-06, never built.

items.title: Tag errors in filenames
items.detail: The miss: from Sep 8 a missing librosa baked its own error text into the MP3 name ("<title> (Missing: librosa ...).mp3") and J only found it on Studio-E-2. Fixed ae70d59, Sep 10 - it now fails cleanly instead.

items.title: Root cause: numba vs numpy
items.detail: "No tags at all" since Sep 8 traced to numba lagging numpy 2.5.3, which broke librosa's import. deps.sh now repairs the pair. PICKUP 2026-09-11.

items.title: deps self-install every launch
items.detail: a5c3e94, Sep 10: every launch checks brew / yt-dlp / ffmpeg / analyzer and installs what is missing; yt-dlp upgrades weekly off a .last-ytdlp-upgrade stamp and again after a failed download, then retries once. J took the 7-day interval over his own 48 h idea.

items.title: BPM research + bench
items.detail: docs/research/bpm-detection-research.md with a re-runnable GiantSteps bench (docs/research/bpm-bench/, run-2026-09-11.txt): Essentia TempoCNN deeptemp-k16-3 87.5% Acc1 / 100% Acc2 vs 30% / 55% for the old code, ~1.7 s per track, no torch.

items.title: Key research + bench
items.detail: docs/research/key-detection-research.md + key-bench/: Essentia HPCP 36-bin with detuning correction scored against Faraldo bgate profiles = 85.1 MIREX / 79.5% exact vs 55.4 / 43.6% for the librosa Krumhansl method. Same wheel fixes both.

items.title: Essentia detectors shipped
items.detail: 0c8c57c, Sep 11 04:16: TempoCNN for BPM and HPCP+bgate for key, replacing librosa. Model models/deeptemp-k16-3.pb vendored in the repo (CC BY-NC-SA, offline).

items.title: Top-3 key + confidence
items.detail: Filenames and output now carry three candidate keys with a percentage from segment agreement and score margin; the true key is in the top 3 on 92% of the benchmark. Stated in README as measured, not as a calibrated probability.

items.title: One analyzer, auto-picked
items.detail: 80d4b55, Sep 11 04:20: deps.sh installs essentia-tensorflow if it imports on that Mac, else librosa plus the numba repair — never both. Keeps Intel Macs working.

items.title: librosa segfault fallback
items.detail: librosa.beat_track segfaults on py3.14 + numba 0.67, so the librosa path uses librosa.feature.tempo instead. PICKUP 2026-09-11.

items.title: Jownloader feeds it
items.detail: The Brave extension (renamed ~/dev/brave_img-downloader → ~/dev/jownloader, commit 109a745 Sep 11) pipes a YouTube URL through a native host into run.sh, so beat_dl runs without the paste loop.

items.title: Auto-Tune harvester spec
items.detail: 1b65912 + 57dfcd3, Sep 12: read-only design for harvesting (beat-only WAV, key, BPM) triples out of J's own mixed Pro Tools sessions, where Auto-Tune's Key+Scale is already ground truth — in-domain hip-hop/R&B instead of the EDM-only public sets. A bypassed Auto-Tune counts as untuned. Nothing run against Pro Tools.
